description: Email a person a one-time sign-in link that opens a named Doing Work screen after they sign in, so an agent can hand its person straight to the page that needs a human (brand, terms, job photos and so on). The screen comes from a fixed list: today, brand, terms, transfer, close, capture, subcontractors, claim, card, hub, start. Shop screens take shop_id; capture and subcontractors take job_id; claim is refused here, because the agent connect flow sends its own link; card and hub take the key from their link. The link works once, in any browser, and expires in 15 minutes. Always answers ok, so it never reveals whether an email has an account. The page still checks that the person may see it.

params.description: Values the screen reads, such as shop_id or job_id.

name: auth_sendLink
